Darren Frate Group featuring the Grandview Trio @ BOP STOP

October 10 from 8:00pm - 10:30pm

Darren Frate Groups music has been described as world music, jazz and jazz fusion woven together by bass driven grooves and improvisation. Many of the compositions touch on eastern rhythms and harmonies combined with jazz influences in order to create a unique combination of styles. The group will be debuting new songs as well as playing compositions from their previous releases "Resonance" and the "Parnell Road Sessions".

This event will also be livestreamed on BOP STOP's Youtube Channel at showtime. Accessing the stream is free but donations are encouraged and directly support the band.
